name: Key Viewer
description: A customizable Geometry Dash input overlay with responsive key surfaces, note timelines, activity meters, and a live editor.

language.name: Editor Language
language.description: Choose Korean or English. Reopen the editor after changing the language.

show-viewer.name: Show Key Viewer
show-viewer.description: Hide or show the whole key viewer. Also available from the editor window.

show-timeline.name: Note Timeline
show-timeline.description: Show presses as bars rising upward.

show-counter.name: Key Counters
show-counter.description: Show the press count inside each key box.

show-kps.name: Default KPS Box Visibility
show-kps.description: Default visibility for the KPS and peak KPS boxes.

show-total.name: Default Total Box Visibility
show-total.description: Default visibility for the total presses box.

show-glow.name: Press Glow
show-glow.description: Soft glow around a key box while it is pressed.

note-glow.name: Note Glow
note-glow.description: Soft glow around the rising note bars.

reset-on-restart.name: Reset On Restart
reset-on-restart.description: Reset counters and KPS on every retry.

jump-width.name: Jump Box Width
jump-width.description: 1.0 is a square box. Raise it for a wider jump box.

box-gap.name: Key Spacing
box-gap.description: Gap for new keys and even spacing in the editor.

label-jump.name: Jump Label
label-jump.description: Letters, numbers and symbols only. Max 6 characters.

gradient-mode.name: Gradient Colors
gradient-mode.description: Notes: notes blend from their color to the gradient end color. Tile: pressed boxes blend too. Both: notes and boxes.

gradient-color.name: Gradient End Color
gradient-color.description: The color at the top of notes and pressed boxes when Gradient Colors is on.

note-width.name: Note Thickness (%)
note-width.description: Note width relative to the box width. 100 matches the box.

note-fade.name: Note Fade
note-fade.description: How fast notes fade as they rise. 0 means no fade.

note-radius.name: Note Roundness (%)
note-radius.description: Corner roundness relative to the note width.

note-border.name: Note Border
note-border.description: Outline thickness around notes. 0 hides it.

note-glow-custom.name: Custom Glow Color
note-glow-custom.description: Use the glow color below instead of the note color.

pos-x.name: Position X (%)
pos-x.description: You can also drag the key viewer while the pause menu is open.

pos-y.name: Position Y (%)
pos-y.description: You can also drag the key viewer while the pause menu is open.

default-surface.name: Default Key Surface
default-surface.description: Choose a finish for keys and statistics boxes that use the default style.

default-impact.name: Default Press Response
default-impact.description: Choose the default accent animation for a key press.

reduce-motion.name: Reduce Extra Motion
reduce-motion.description: Disable impact effects, key travel, hold meters and counter animations. Keep the input timeline.
